title: The full blueprint
what: The whole blueprint in one document: every design detail, check and caveat. Long and technical.

title: Design options report
what: An earlier report that compares candidate designs and explains how they are ranked.

title: Context–Evidence Graph (1,151 studies)
what: 1,151 primary empirical studies, 7,659 experimental and control groups, 14,105 structured outcomes and 2,447 links to blueprint checkpoints, screened from 3,922 candidate records.

title: All findings
what: Every finding pulled out of the studies, one per line, with its source and quotations where sharing is allowed.

title: How the studies link together
what: The web of connections between studies and genes, for exploring the evidence as a network.

title: Idea Graveyard data
what: The Idea Graveyard rules, in a form that software can read and enforce.

title: Data format rules
what: The rules every finding must follow, so anyone can check that none have been bent.

title: File list with fingerprints
what: Every file in this release with a unique fingerprint (SHA-256), so you can confirm your copy is unchanged.
